verdictScope: Every gate that an agent can measure reproduces, in Chrome and WebKit at both sizes where specified, and no blocking defect was found. Two gates belong to the owner and stay open by design: the owner's visual review and the owner-eye seam check of a V3 under-table orbit. G2 is not accepted until the owner has seen the images.
label: illustrative — needs certified-clinician review (DN5; CR-09, CR-36)

browsers.webkit: Playwright WebKit 27.2 on Windows (approximates Safari, not Safari)

method: The diff c2b9409..ff8705c was read line by line. Every G2 gate was re-measured with code written for this verification (scripts/g2-probe.mjs). It has its own bone-to-segment table. It re-skins every vertex of all four patient skinned meshes and casts its own vertical lines through every drawn, visible table-top triangle, the head ring included (4,636 triangles, bucketed). A per-mesh parity test decides whether a vertex is inside a solid, and the depth is read below that mesh's top. The lowest gap is read over the drawn surface under each vertex. The app's restSupport() is never used for these numbers. The same probe ran on an exported base tree (git archive c2b9409) for before values. Extra probes: arm overhang past the pad edge, lowest gap per third of each limb segment, rest stability over 10 s, an 8-frame under-table orbit (scripts/g2-extra.mjs), column-area mesh bounds in both trees (scripts/base-parts.mjs), pose-tween speeds in both trees (scripts/tween-probe.mjs), and WebKit boot probes base vs G2 (scripts/boot-probe.mjs). Suites ran on ports 4800-4809 with their own servers. Scripts carry absolute paths of this machine.

webkitBoot.reading: With fresh processes neither tree loses a context. With one shared process, losses come every 3-4 loads by position (3, 6/7, 10/11, 14) in both orders, and they hit both trees. In both orders they fell mostly on G2 positions: 6 of 16 G2 loads against 2 of 16 base loads (Fisher exact p about 0.22, not significant). This matches U21 and the implementer's single-tree runs. Not a G2 defect on this evidence; a larger single-tree probe would settle it

This is not a trainee manipulation path; leave it to G3's pose-tween handling
